analysis_plan: Verify main/replay population fingerprints, binding permutations, selected target hashes, prediction hashes, exact counts, and numerical metrics after normalizing only run-local paths and IDs.

For each layer and assignment, report the random and balanced zero-reference contrast RMS, their ratio, full four-cell loading, common positive headroom, references outside active bounds, sign flips, and voltage RMS.

Report exact correct/10000 and accuracy for random@random and balanced@balanced calibration, plus paired balanced-minus-random deltas for every held-out assignment and their arithmetic mean and full range.

Cross-apply both development-selected calibrations to both bindings. Use balanced@cal_random minus random@cal_random and balanced@cal_balanced minus random@cal_balanced as fixed-calibration binding effects.

Interpret a large contrast reduction without accuracy recovery as evidence that loading, headroom, or another full-conductance effect remains after reference balancing; do not attribute it to quantization, training, or P&V, which are absent.

arms.description: Primary native ideal continuous random-versus-balanced four-reference evaluation.
Independent native semantic replay of the exact primary contract.

completion_criteria: Both declared native validate arms complete from the frozen pre-BPTT checkpoint and teacher, cover development assignment 86001 and held-out assignments 87001-87003, and evaluate all 10000 test examples per held-out binding/calibration arm.

The balanced binding is a deterministic, bijective, within-layer permutation of exactly the same sampled identities, uses no weights, labels, bounds, calibration outcomes, or test results, and its main/replay plan hashes match.

Every selected physical branch is finite and nonnegative, every active branch is within its sampled bounds, every mapping records B, d, and G with zero decomposition residual, and the full G enters both four-rail contrast and loading.
Optimizer updates, quantization, pulse programming, HWA, deployment write noise, inference read noise, retention, and drift are exactly absent.
The primary accuracy gate passes only if balanced@balanced held-out mean accuracy is at least 90 percent. Failure is retained and interpreted rather than repaired after inspection.
hypothesis: Weight-blind identity binding that minimizes the signed intrinsic-reference sum of each four-cell quad will strongly reduce zero-weight contrast and recover at least 90 percent held-out ideal bounded continuous initialization accuracy relative to the sampled identity order.
motivation: The exact-r four-device continuous control reached only 71.11 percent despite a 97.38 percent homogeneous-reference upper control. This study isolates baseline quality before choosing level spacing or level count: it changes only which complete sampled identities form each quad and keeps every physical conductance as G=B+d in the full circuit equations.
title: Four-device intrinsic-reference identity balance at ideal initialization
